title: Renewal dates and terms diverge
source_story: User-provided fictional owner stories in this conversation; opening narrative below is a faithful condensed adaptation, not a verbatim transcript.
business_context: Rental and maintenance provider; approximately 140 active agreements.
owner_narrative: Contracts, billing and the renewal spreadsheet are separate. Email extensions and added equipment remain in messages. A customer arranged a competitor’s copier while we thought renewal was months away. Sales lacks a reliable service history before discussing the next agreement.

diagnostic_interview.question: Which document controls the date?
diagnostic_interview.synthetic_answer: A later email extension was accepted but never reflected in the sheet.
diagnostic_interview.branch_if_answer_differs: A customer with a deliberate competitive tender needs tender tracking; an earlier reminder alone may not retain it.

diagnostic_interview.question: Who owns renewal follow-up?
diagnostic_interview.synthetic_answer: Sales and accounts each assumed the other was tracking it.
diagnostic_interview.branch_if_answer_differs: Revise the causal hypothesis and request the corresponding source record; do not reuse this fictional answer for a new customer.

diagnostic_interview.question: Are notice deadlines different from expiry?
diagnostic_interview.branch_if_answer_differs: Revise the causal hypothesis and request the corresponding source record; do not reuse this fictional answer for a new customer.

diagnostic_interview.question: Can offers be sent automatically?
diagnostic_interview.synthetic_answer: Service complaints or old equipment can change the proposal.
diagnostic_interview.diagnostic_value: Prepare review, not generic sales sending.

evidence.description: A simulated amendment changes the end date.
A simulated spreadsheet retains the original date.
A simulated account has unresolved repeat failures.

diagnoses.hypothesis: Agreement versions and decision deadlines are not reconciled into an owned renewal workflow.
diagnoses.counterhypothesis: A customer with a deliberate competitive tender needs tender tracking; an earlier reminder alone may not retain it.
diagnoses.confidence_policy: Qualitative case-world support only; requires fresh customer evidence before reuse.

interventions.process_first: Review the current agreement and amendments; assign an account owner and separate notice, review and end dates.
interventions.deterministic_and_assisted_automation: Extract date candidates for review; maintain effective terms; prepare account summaries and internal renewal tasks.
interventions.rejected_default: Do not replace the whole service platform or deploy autonomous agents solely because the owner reports inefficiency.
interventions.selection_basis: Choose the least complex intervention addressing the supported handoff failure; compare added administration and integration burden.

requirements.statement: Conflicting dates require review before reminders claim certainty.
requirements.rationale: Agreement versions and decision deadlines are not reconciled into an owned renewal workflow.

requirements.statement: No automatic renewal offer without account-owner approval.
requirements.rationale: Agreement versions and decision deadlines are not reconciled into an owned renewal workflow.

requirements.statement: A new amendment supersedes applicable fields while preserving history.
requirements.rationale: Agreement versions and decision deadlines are not reconciled into an owned renewal workflow.

acceptance_tests.scenario_and_expected_result: Conflicting expiry dates create a review item.
Notice deadline triggers earlier than expiry when configured.
Open service complaints appear in the review brief.

capability_boundary.proposed_extension: Agreement versioning and renewal management are proposed additions.
capability_boundary.pricing: No price assigned; current rate card must not be extended by analogy.

evaluation.primary_metric_definition: Agreements reviewed before their applicable decision deadline / agreements with deadlines in period.
measurement_cautions: Use a stable denominator and comparable operating periods.
Record missingness and changed case mix.
Do not infer staff reductions from reclaimed task minutes.

implementation.baseline: Collect at least one representative operating cycle before rollout; for monthly billing or maintenance include the relevant full cycle. Extend sampling when volumes or seasonality make the sample unrepresentative.
implementation.scope: Start with one consenting customer group and the staff who own its handoffs; include a normal case and each listed exception.
sequence: Reconcile identities and existing obligations with the process owner.
Run the proposed rules in shadow mode; record disagreements and missed exceptions.
Approve a bounded live pilot only after requirements and exceptions have named owners.
Review outcome metrics, added administrative work and failure logs before expanding.
implementation.simulated_resolution: In this fictional case, MILO introduced the process change: Review the current agreement and amendments; assign an account owner and separate notice, review and end dates. The team adopted the proposed workflow for the pilot scope. Routine coordination became explicit; unresolved exceptions continued to require a person.
implementation.simulated_lesson: A customer with a deliberate competitive tender needs tender tracking; an earlier reminder alone may not retain it.
implementation.rollback: Pause automated writes and notifications, retain the event log, export outstanding work and return to a named manual coordinator. Reconcile queued events before resuming to avoid duplicate actions.
implementation.go_no_go: Process owner reviews coverage of acceptance cases, unresolved critical failures, metric direction and staff workload. No fixed performance threshold is claimed without customer agreement.

open_questions: Notice interpretations, negotiation lead time and completeness of amendments need review.

transfer_rules.applicable_when: Agreement versions and decision deadlines are not reconciled into an owned renewal workflow.
transfer_rules.do_not_assume: A customer with a deliberate competitive tender needs tender tracking; an earlier reminder alone may not retain it.
